    for a,b in zip\(src,dst\):

price=300000; comm=0.05; roy=0.06; fund=0.015; tot=roy+fund
ext=0.5; gross=price*comm; into=gross*\(1-ext\)
sel_br=gross-price*0.025
sel_wl_new=gross-price*0.015
sel_wl_old=gross-price*0.020
br_eoy=[0,1,2,3,5]; wl_eoy=[2,5,10,15,20]; dev=[1,3,6,10,15]; ramp=[.5,.6,.7,.75,.8]
opex=[150+80+60+40+30+40+30+15, 220+70+40+30+50+50+35+15, 300+80+40+30+70+60+45+20,
      400+90+40+35+90+70+55+25, 500+100+40+40+110+80+65+30]
opex=[o*1000 for o in opex]
def avg\(l,i\): return \(\(l[i-1] if i else 0\)+l[i]\)/2
print\("%-22s%12s%12s%12s%12s%12s" % \('','Y1','Y2','Y3','Y4','Y5'\)\)
base=[];new=[];wlsel=[]
for i in range\(5\):
    b=avg\(br_eoy,i\); w=avg\(wl_eoy,i\); r=ramp[i]
    nb=br_eoy[i]-\(br_eoy[i-1] if i else 0\); nw=wl_eoy[i]-\(wl_eoy[i-1] if i else 0\)
    rev=\(nb*30000 + b*1000*12 + b*50*0.7*into*tot*r + b*50*0.3*sel_br*r
         + nw*12000 + w*1800*12 + \(b+w\)*100*12 + dev[i]*40000\)
    s=w*25*0.08*sel_wl_new*r
    base.append\(rev\); wlsel.append\(s\); new.append\(rev+s\)
def row\(lbl,v,pct=False\):
    cells=''.join\(\('%11.0f%%'%\(x*100\) if pct else '%12s'%\('{:,.0f}'.format\(x\)\)\) for x in v\)
    print\('%-22s%s'%\(lbl,cells\)\)
row\('v0.7 revenue',base\); row\('+ WL Select \(NEW\)',wlsel\); row\('v0.8 revenue',new\)
print\(\)
row\('OPEX',opex\)
eb0=[base[i]-opex[i] for i in range\(5\)]; eb1=[new[i]-opex[i] for i in range\(5\)]
row\('v0.7 EBITDA',eb0\); row\('v0.8 EBITDA',eb1\)
row\('v0.8 margin',[eb1[i]/new[i] for i in range\(5\)],True\)
print\(\)
print\('HQ retained per Select unit \($300k\):'\)
print\('  branded, 2.5%% payout:     $%s'%'{:,.0f}'.format\(sel_br\)\)
print\('  white-label 2.0%% \(old\):   $%s'%'{:,.0f}'.format\(sel_wl_old\)\)
print\('  white-label 1.5%% \(new\):   $%s'%'{:,.0f}'.format\(sel_wl_new\)\)
print\(\)
print\('Y5 sensitivity on WL Select mix \(units/yr = 25\):'\)
for mix in \(0.0,0.04,0.08,0.12,0.20\):
    s=avg\(wl_eoy,4\)*25*mix*sel_wl_new*0.8
    print\('  mix %5.0f%% -> new line $%10s   Y5 EBITDA $%10s'%\(mix*100,'{:,.0f}'.format\(s\),'{:,.0f}'.format\(base[4]+s-opex[4]\)\)\)
